doses.note: Doxycycline per DOH leptospirosis guidance: 200 mg single dose within 24 to 72 h of low-risk exposure; 200 mg once daily for 3 to 5 days for moderate or high risk. Not for children under 8 or pregnant women. Confirm current guidance with the CHO.

stock_checklist: Penicillin G and ceftriaxone for severe cases

advisory.en: Avoid wading in floodwater. If you waded, see a health center if you get a fever within 2 weeks.
advisory.fil: Iwasang lumusong sa baha. Kung lumusong ka, magpatingin sa health center kapag nilagnat sa loob ng 2 linggo.

recommend.advisory_audience: Working-age men, who make up most cases

sources.drain_clearing: DOH environmental sanitation and rodent control guidance
